answer: Because the island burn is recorded at the crystal settlement, the forge audit shows the destroyed amount and the recipient of the rest. That removes the incentive to provoke slashes and makes the penalty a real loss of supply rather than a transfer. 69% of every slash is burned and the remainder goes to the wronged party, so no one can profit from a farm's failure except the party it harmed. A 152 account operation therefore ties up 17 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
